evals.prompt: Run the equity:phase-1-screen command with arguments: top down, core/growth, cybersecurity
evals.expected_output: A sector overview report for cybersecurity saved under Equity-analyses/Core/Screening/, generated via equity-research:sector. The agent should classify the equity as Core, use top-down approach, invoke equity-research:sector, and stop at Phase 1.
assertions: The agent classifies the equity type as Core (not Defensive or Satellite)
The agent selects the top-down entry point and invokes equity-research:sector (not screen or catalysts)
The output is saved to a path matching Equity-analyses/Core/Screening/
The agent does not proceed to Phase 2 or beyond (no initiating coverage, DCF, or comps)

evals.prompt: Run the equity:phase-1-screen command with arguments: bottom-up, satellite, high-growth software companies with strong FCF and insider buying, trading below 5-year average NTM P/S multiple
evals.expected_output: A stock screen for high-growth software satellite names saved under Equity-analyses/Satellite/Screening/, generated via equity-research:screen with the user's criteria. Agent classifies as Satellite, uses bottom-up approach.
assertions: The agent classifies the equity type as Satellite
The agent selects the bottom-up entry point and invokes equity-research:screen (not sector or catalysts)
The screening criteria reference FCF strength and/or insider buying and/or NTM P/S valuation
The output is saved to a path matching Equity-analyses/Satellite/Screening/
The agent does not proceed to Phase 2 or beyond

evals.prompt: Run the equity:phase-1-screen command with arguments: event-driven, defensive, utilities sector — looking for dividend plays with upcoming analyst days or regulatory decisions ahead of expected rate cuts
evals.expected_output: A catalyst calendar or event-driven idea list for defensive utility names saved under Equity-analyses/Defensive/Screening/, generated via equity-research:catalysts. Agent classifies as Defensive, uses event-driven approach.
assertions: The agent classifies the equity type as Defensive
The agent selects the event-driven entry point and invokes equity-research:catalysts (not sector or screen)
The output references upcoming events, catalysts, or dividend-related triggers in utilities
The output is saved to a path matching Equity-analyses/Defensive/Screening/
The agent does not proceed to Phase 2 or beyond
